diagnosis is right. `exp=xpe` in the baseUrl means the video is in youtube's PO token rollout, and no IP rotation or cookies get around it. timedtext returns 200 with an empty body unless the request has a valid `pot=` param, which is minted by botguard inside the player js. that's why it works in a normal browser. fwiw I probe this stuff regularly from clean residential IPs and the share of videos with the xpe marker is growing, so this gets worse not better.

what actually works today: yt-dlp (its js runtime solves the player challenges and mints PO tokens, `--write-auto-subs` succeeds on these videos), or drive a real browser with playwright and read the transcript panel. this lib has no PO token path and jdepoix has said he'd rather avoid a js runtime dep, so I wouldn't hold my breath for a fix here.

full disclosure, I maintain a hosted extractor that handles the token + egress problem server side: https://apify.com/fetchworks/youtube-transcript-scraper, $2/1k delivered. notes at https://github.com/Fetchworks/guides.
